caption: The drawing shows a single piece of fabric, folded lengthwise, that is mostly rectangular in shape and rendered in shades of gray. The fabric has intricate decorative patterns: along the upper section, a horizontal floral band features a series of small flower or star-like designs. Below that, there is a wide decorative band composed of repeating circular motifs filled with lace-like patterns inside each circle. This section is bordered above and below by narrow, detailed bands with geometric latticework. The lower part of the fabric transitions into a knotted and netted area forming a diamond mesh pattern. At the very bottom, long, straight fringes hang down, forming an even row. The paper's background is plain and uncolored, and the delicate pencil or graphite shading clearly distinguishes the textures and patterns of the textile.
title: Embroidered Cloth
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
